signals.summary: Five WARN notices covering 76 California employees, mostly at Irvine headquarters.
Workforce reduction in Irvine included many engineers, managers and designers.
Founder and CEO Joe Kiani resigned after losing a proxy battle with Politan Capital.
Danaher agreed to acquire Masimo in a $9.9 billion deal.
Masimo agreed to sell its consumer audio division to Samsung's Harman for US$350 million.
Masimo reported revenue of US$2.09 billion for 2024.
